verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) rose by 0.00 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2019 (90% interval −0.03 to +0.02). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 59 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.98). Counted by gap size instead, 25 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.43). But: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.03 vs typical 0.01).
reasons: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.03 vs typical 0.01)
